brief: 30 s English promo with voice over for an open motion-graphics skill pack for Claude Code; every frame is code

typography: letters drift in from scattered blurred grey positions and settle into ink
structure: numbered countdown, each item: command, prompt card, payoff line
object: dark prompt card with the command chip hanging on a dashed wire
transition: black starbursts sweep corners to frame each new item
color: grey grid paper, black ink, one red pill as the only saturated element

rhythm: one spoken phrase per shot, about 1.5 s, the world flips between cream paper and black void
typography: each line has one red key word set larger than the rest
object: one hero object per line acts out the phrase (bulb, briefcase, keyboard, emoji)
transition: a thick grey ribbon road sweeps through cream scenes and carries the eye
light: red words glow in a black void like neon

transition: one easing curve with handles describes how every value moves over time
object: keyframe diamonds sit on the curve and mark decisions
structure: a playhead sweeps left to right and everything it crosses changes state
